title: How long they had been with Nazarro by 1921
summary: Pressed on the chronology, Bubbles says they had been together two years, 1919-21, and that Nazarro was selfish and kept them from a name.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Wasn't this at the beginning of your relationship when you began to realize what was happening with the money?
No, how could I know that. I done played the Palace Theater,

I played the Columbia Theater, I went off to California, I'm just coming to California. How much time have I had to find out? That's the first time I saw two checks for the act of Buck and Bubbles. How could I do that? Go ahead, you tell me. Have you been following the story? You missed it.
You did what? What? Now, you didn't follow the story.
(Inaudible) in terms of how many years you'd been with him at that point when you first went out to California.
How many years you'd been together by the time you went out to California.
What are you talking about -- oh, I see what you -- your point is how many years we'd been together --
Two years and you already were successful to go out to Hollywood at that point, had established a big enough reputation to --

It would have been bigger than what it was if the manager hadn't been so selfish in his own way. He didn't want us to get a name because he thought we'd leave him, that's why he was like that. But I had a thought, I just had a thought of making a name. I had to fight like a dog to get that name up in lights, man. That was some trouble, I mean that was trouble. Anyway, getting back to the point of doing the shorts and finding the checks and all, he got worse instead of getting better. I didn't think he was going to get worse. I thought he'd try to settle up. No, it was mine to realize he had made a thief out of himself before some people really appreciate his every effort set forth in our behalf, you know. I
